en.topic_title: 2 domestic workers acquitted of illegal dentistry as Hong Kong authorities accused of staging a ‘show’ during arrests
en.topic_summary:
Two Filipina domestic workers have been acquitted of practising illegal dentistry in Hong Kong after the defence raised concerns that authorities staged a “show” during their arrest.



This photo provided by Hong Kong’s Immigration Department shows an arrest operation on August 17, 2025, in which six Filipina domestic workers were apprehended on suspicion of running an unlicensed dental clinic in Sham Shui Po. Photo: GovHK.



Jucen Lihaylihay Naong and Rowena Marcaida Cerdina were cleare
